tooltip.english_name: If the original entry's name is not in english, this must be a translation. This may be revised when reviewing your entry.
tooltip.original_name: This should be the original name as it appears on a brand listing, e.g. Midnight Dollワンピース. Also known as "Foreign name".
tooltip.brand: If this is an indie brand, use the most appropriate brand (e.g. Indie Brand or Chinese Indie Brand) and add their tag below.
tooltip.product_number: If you are unsure of how to find a product number on certain brands, ask in #junior-help on Discord
tooltip.year: If there is an expected ship date provided for a preorder that will have a significant wait time, you can put it in the Notes field.
tooltip.currency: It's very rare to not have a price on a newer release, but for historical data just document this in the Notes field.
tooltip.price: If an item is genuinely free, enter a price of 0 with an appropriate currency.
tooltip.categories: If you are unsure of what item categories should contain which items, please take a look at the wiki.
tooltip.features: Features are exclusively about physical characteristics of the item. Please do not guess!
tooltip.tags: Tags are any other information about the item or entry.
tooltip.colors: Pick the option that best matches the item and the official colorways.
tooltip.notes: Notes are any other important information shown on the website, e.g. names of colorways, shipping details, brand comments from their listing.
helptext.english_name: The english name of this entry.
helptext.original_name: The original/native-language name of this entry, if not in english.
helptext.brand: The brand of this entry, e.g. Angelic Pretty.
helptext.slug: The url to this entry, items/{slug}. Editable by admins.
helptext.product_number: The original product number or code, if known.
helptext.year: "Released" means the year the item is made available for purchase, even if the delivery date is in a different year.
helptext.currency: Unknown here hides the entire price from the entry page.
helptext.price: Item price; only shown if currency is present.
helptext.attributes: Attributes are not required, but are recommended!
helptext.notes: This is the notes that appear alongside an item on the site.
helptext.internal_notes: Please provide sources, and image credits here, as well as any other information that may be helpful.
